description_en: Deletes a rule configured in a specified protection module by calling DeleteProtectionModuleRule
description_zh: 调用DeleteProtectionModuleRule删除指定防护模块中配置的规则
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi delete-protection-module-rule --domain www.aliyundoc.com --defense-type ac_custom --rule-id 42754 --instance-id waf-cn-mp91530000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteProtectionModuleRule

parameters.help_en:
The domain name for which you want to delete the protection rule.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html to query all domain names that are added to WAF
parameters.help_zh:
要删除防护规则的域名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html查询所有已接入WAF防护的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The protection feature module to which the rule to be deleted belongs. Valid values:

waf-codec: the decoding settings of the RegEx Protection DPI engine.

tamperproof: web tamper-proofing rules.

dlp: data leak prevention rules.

ng_account: account security rules.

antifraud: data risk control protection request configurations.

antifraud_js: data risk control JS insertion page configurations.

bot_algorithm: intelligent algorithm rules of Bot Management.

bot_wxbb_pkg: version protection rules of App Protection.

bot_wxbb: path protection rules of App Protection.

ac_custom: custom protection policy rules.

whitelist: whitelist rules
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的防护规则所属防护功能模块。取值：

waf-codec：表示规则防护引擎解码设置。

tamperproof：表示网站防篡改规则配置。

dlp：表示防敏感信息泄漏规则配置。

ng_account：表示账户安全规则配置。

antifraud：表示数据风控防护请求配置。

antifraud_js：表示数据风控JS插入页面配置。

bot_algorithm：表示Bot管理的智能算法规则。

bot_wxbb_pkg：表示App防护的版本防护规则。

bot_wxbb：表示App防护的路径防护规则。

ac_custom：表示自定义防护策略规则配置。

whitelist：表示白名单规则配置
parameters.name: defense_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the protection rule to delete.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100398.html to query the IDs of all rules in a specified protection module
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的防护规则的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100398.html查询指定防护功能模块下的所有规则ID
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management. By default, this parameter is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
